verdict.rationale: Wise publishes extensive API reference pages, including .md variants, and an llms.txt file. Neither is a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and the probe found that every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The axis applies to an API-offering fintech, but nothing in the pack shows a downloadable spec, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
